stops.note: 'antidote to venomous bites', from thērion 'wild beast'; the physician Galen prepared theriac for Emperor Marcus Aurelius to take daily
a complex remedy of dozens of ingredients, bound with lots of honey
a cure-all medicine; 'Venice treacle' was a famous imported brand
the sweet syrup that carried the medicine gave its name to the syrup left from sugar refining

current_meaning: thick sticky syrup from refining sugar; cloying sentimentality
